data.change_summary: Tightened the structured tracing stack so external sinks no longer fail silently, tick ids remain monotonic after `drain_ticks()`, pool-delta reporting suppresses floating-point noise with a relative/absolute threshold, and detail tracing now covers the previously missing shrimp/stability/internal-state fields while rejecting unsupported pool lookups explicitly instead of treating them as unchanged. The tracer API now exposes sink-failure inspection and total emitted tick count, engine docs clarify that clones drop tracing because sinks are not cloneable, and integration coverage was updated to assert the expanded daily-shrimp/stability-tracker detail schema alongside sink-failure and monotonic-id behavior.

steps.description: Inspected the current tracing API, engine clone/tracing behavior, and existing unit/integration coverage against the five pending amendments to map the required code and test changes.

Patched the tracing facilities to surface sink write/serialization failures, keep tick numbering monotonic across drained buffers, use a practical delta threshold, expand the tracked detail-schema surface for internal shrimp/stability state, and make unsupported pool lookups explicit.
Updated engine-facing tracing documentation to state that cloned engines do not retain tracer configuration and callers must re-enable tracing on scenario forks when needed.

Extended tracing tests to cover sink-failure retention, monotonic tick ids after draining, and newly tracked daily shrimp/stability-tracker internal deltas, then ran focused and full-package validation.

validation_evidence: `cargo test -p tank_core` passed the full `tank_core` test suite.
